sentences.en: There's a lot of money at stake in this transaction.
sentences.zh: 这笔交易涉及大量的资金。

sentences.en: This transaction was carried out in yen, rather than US dollars.
sentences.zh: 这次交易是以日元进行的，而不是美元。

sentences.en: I have to close this transaction within a week.
sentences.zh: 我必须在一周内完成这笔交易。

senses.zh: 交易，买卖，业务；（学术团体会议的）议事录，公报；（人与人之间的）交流，相互影响；事务（元），事项
